execution_hints: Use one deterministic local script when helpful; place it in the current workspace root, never an operating-system temporary directory.
Do not install dependencies or use network access; use the standard library and only packages that already import successfully.
Write text artifacts explicitly as UTF-8 and keep generated source ASCII-safe on Windows by using Unicode escape sequences when needed.
method_contract: Run a directed least-cost search on time_minutes, not geometric distance.
Represent search state with enough incoming-path context to enforce each forbidden turn; a node-only visited state is insufficient when turn restrictions exist.
Use deterministic node-ID ordering when equal-cost alternatives remain after all declared constraints are applied.

requirements: Use this exact column order and write one row for every listed destination.
Serialize node paths as greater-than-separated node IDs with no spaces, for example NODE1>NODE2; do not write JSON arrays or pipe-separated paths.
For unreachable destinations write lowercase false and empty CSV cells for travel_time_minutes and path; never write the literal text null or None.
Use a FeatureCollection in the fixture CRS.
Write exactly one LineString feature per reachable destination.
Route coordinates must follow the reported node path order.
Use the same greater-than-separated path representation as the CSV.
Report counts from the produced destination rows rather than hard-coding them.
